name: MonarchChartFrame
title: ChartFrame
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.material3.Surface (through MonarchCard), MonarchChartLegend, MonarchSkeleton, MonarchEmptyState, MonarchInlineErrorRetry
summary: The card a chart sits in: title, description, header controls, legend, loading, empty and error states that keep the chart's height, and the chart's data as a table through "View as table".
whenToUse: Around every chart on a dashboard or report screen, so each chart has a name, a legend, consistent states and a text alternative of its data.
whenNotToUse: For a word-sized trend in a table row or a stat tile use MonarchSparkline on its own. For a single number use a stat or MonarchDeltaIndicator.
api: @Composable fun MonarchChartFrame(title: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, description: String? = null, status: MonarchChartFrameStatus = MonarchChartFrameStatus.Ready, table: MonarchChartTable? = null, legend: List<MonarchChartLegendItem> = emptyList(), hiddenSeries: Set<String> = emptySet(), onHiddenSeriesChange: ((Set<String>) -> Unit)? = null, legendMarker: MonarchChartLegendMarker = MonarchChartLegendMarker.Line, emptyMessage: String? = null, footer: String? = null, height: Dp = 240.dp, tableToggle: Boolean = true, onRetry: (() -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchChartFrameLabels = MonarchChartFrameLabels(), actions: (@Composable RowScope.() -> Unit)? = null, content: @Composable BoxScope.() -> Unit)
enum class MonarchChartFrameStatus { Ready, Loading, Empty, Error }
class MonarchChartTable(categoryTitle: String, categories: List<String>, series: List<MonarchChartTableSeries>)
class MonarchChartTableSeries(name: String, values: List<Double?>, formattedValues: List<String>? = null)

class MonarchChartFrameLabels(viewTable: String? = null, viewChart: String? = null, loading: String? = null, emptyTitle: String? = null, error: String? = null, legend: String? = null, noValue: String? = null, showAll: String? = null)

options.name: title
options.description: The chart's name, shown as a heading.

options.name: description
options.description: One line under the title: the period, the unit or what the chart answers.

options.name: table
options.description: The chart's data: categories by series. Enables "View as table".

options.name: legend
options.description: Legend entries, shown with MonarchChartLegend while the chart is visible.

options.name: hiddenSeries
options.description: The hidden series keys, used with onHiddenSeriesChange.

options.name: onHiddenSeriesChange
options.description: Makes the legend entries toggles; called with the new hidden set.

options.name: emptyMessage
options.description: The message of the empty state.

options.name: footer
options.description: Notes under the chart: the source, the last update.

options.name: height
options.description: The height kept for the body in every status. The empty and error states grow when their text needs more room.

options.name: tableToggle
options.description: Offers "View as table" when there is a table.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Shows Try again in the Error status.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for the built-in strings: View as table, View as chart, Loading chart, No data yet, This chart didn't load., Legend, No value, Show all.

options.name: actions
options.description: Controls at the end of the header, such as a period picker.

options.name: content
options.description: The chart, in a box of the frame's width and height.

states.name: ready
states.description: The chart, the legend and, when there is a table, the "View as table" button; after it, the data table in the chart's place and "View as chart".

states.name: loading
states.description: A MonarchSkeleton of the chart's height, read as "Loading chart" with an indeterminate progress value.

states.name: empty
states.description: MonarchEmptyState with "No data yet" and the empty message.

states.name: error
states.description: MonarchInlineErrorRetry with "This chart didn't load." and Try again when onRetry is set; otherwise the message in the strong danger color as a polite live region.

appearance: A MonarchCard: the surface color with the default border and 12dp corners. The title in the strong body style, the description and footer in the muted caption color, the table header in the label style over a default-border line and rows over subtle-border lines. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web ChartFrame is a figure that always renders the data table for screen readers; Android has no hidden-but-readable content and no chart descriptor equivalent of iOS's AXChartDescriptor, so the data reaches TalkBack through "View as table", whose rows are each read as the category and every series with its value. The table view state is kept inside the frame (rememberSaveable), as on iOS; the web's controlled showTable and onShowTableChange are not offered. The web's headingLevel is not offered (Compose has one heading property) and emptyActions is not offered, as on iOS. onLegendToggle becomes hiddenSeries and onHiddenSeriesChange, as on iOS. The table columns share the width equally and text wraps; the web table scrolls sideways instead. Same names as iOS: MonarchChartTable, MonarchChartTableSeries, MonarchChartFrameLabels, MonarchChartFrameStatus; iOS's isTableToggleShown is tableToggle here. The web retry that keeps the button busy until a promise settles is not offered: retrying is the app's status change.
accessibility: With a table, "View as table" is a button with a touch target of at least 48dp; the table's header row is one heading element and each row is one element read as the category, then each series and its value, with "No value" for a gap.
The loading skeleton is one element named "Loading chart" with an indeterminate progress value.
The error without retry is a polite live region, so a change to the error status is announced; with onRetry it is MonarchInlineErrorRetry.
Without a table, the chart content keeps its own semantics; give it a description, as MonarchSparkline does.
The title wraps at font scale 2.0.
edgeCases: Gaps (null values) show a dash and are read as "No value".
Values without formattedValues are formatted with the locale's number format (android.icu.text.NumberFormat).
Many series make table columns narrow; their text wraps.
Loading and the chart keep exactly the given height; the empty and error states use it as a minimum.
While the status is not Ready the body shows that status; a table view chosen before comes back when the status is Ready again.

examples.template:
MonarchChartFrame(
    title = {{title}},
    description = {{description}},
    table = MonarchChartTable(
        categoryTitle = {{dayTitle}},
        categories = listOf({{week.0.day}}, {{week.1.day}}, {{week.2.day}}, {{week.3.day}}, {{week.4.day}}),
        series = listOf(MonarchChartTableSeries({{legend.label}}, listOf({{week.0.requests|double}}, {{week.1.requests|double}}, {{week.2.requests|double}}, {{week.3.requests|double}}, {{week.4.requests|double}}))),
    ),
    legend = listOf(MonarchChartLegendItem({{legend.key}}, {{legend.label}}, color = MonarchChartColor.Data1)),
    footer = {{footer}},
    height = {{height}}.dp,
    actions = {
        MonarchSegmentedControl(
            options = ranges.map { it.second },
            selectedIndex = ranges.indexOfFirst { it.first == range },
            onSelect = { range = ranges[it].first },
            size = MonarchSegmentedControlSize.Sm,
        )
    },
) {
    MonarchSparkline(
        values = listOf({{week.0.requests|double}}, {{week.1.requests|double}}, {{week.2.requests|double}}, {{week.3.requests|double}}, {{week.4.requests|double}}),
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().fillMaxHeight(),
        variant = MonarchSparklineVariant.Area,
        color = MonarchChartColor.Data1,
    )
}
examples.code:
MonarchChartFrame(
    title = "Requests",
    description = "New requests per day",
    table = MonarchChartTable(
        categoryTitle = "Day",
        categories = listOf("Mon", "Tue", "Wed", "Thu", "Fri"),
        series = listOf(MonarchChartTableSeries("Requests", listOf(48.0, 61.0, 55.0, 72.0, 66.0))),
    ),
    legend = listOf(MonarchChartLegendItem("requests", "Requests", color = MonarchChartColor.Data1)),
    footer = "Counts update every hour.",
    height = 96.dp,
    actions = {
        MonarchSegmentedControl(
            options = ranges.map { it.second },
            selectedIndex = ranges.indexOfFirst { it.first == range },
            onSelect = { range = ranges[it].first },
            size = MonarchSegmentedControlSize.Sm,
        )
    },
) {
    MonarchSparkline(
        values = listOf(48.0, 61.0, 55.0, 72.0, 66.0),
        modifier = Modifier.fillMaxWidth().fillMaxHeight(),
        variant = MonarchSparklineVariant.Area,
        color = MonarchChartColor.Data1,
    )
}
